new_defects: N1 Catch-up is STEP 6 only. A vendor pitch (6b, or Saurabh's vendor forward in 6a) that lands in quiet hours or whose send fails is never looped in, since 6 to 6e work only on messages this run read.

N2 Catch-up re-read load: 'pitch Activities' is undefined and nothing marks a pitch deliberately skipped (repeat, closed row, our side already replied, quiet hours). Each such pitch is re-read by Message-ID (search + read + THREAD) every hourly run for 72 hours, up to about 72 times. Add: only after quiet hours end; skip rows whose Claude note says 'loop-in skipped: <why>'.

N3 include_folders inbox+sent+archive: if 'archive' is Gmail's All Mail, every message is listed twice and read+original runs per copy. The order is read first, then original, then dedupe, so logged messages are read too. Fix: original first (or read with body_max_chars 0), dedupe by Message-ID, then read only new ones; or search archive alone if it is All Mail.

N4 Poison message: a message that always fails to log pins 'read to'. Each run then re-lists and re-reads everything since (up to 3 days), and at 3 days the cap drops it silently. Add: after 2 failed runs, log it as skipped with the error and move on.
N5 A new-mail loop-in (Saurabh-only or Akshay-forwarded pitch) has no In-Reply-To. If its Activity log fails, catch-up after the 24h idempotency window sees no loop-in and can send a second.
N6 MAILBOX maps rfc822msgid two ways.
N7 since is date-only, so each hourly run lists 1 to 2 days of mail (I1: 160 messages, 2 pages). email_read takes a datetime: since = T.
